newsitem.title: USA: Quest Medical sees year loss $0.05.
newsitem.headline: Quest Medical sees year loss $0.05.

text.p: Quest Medical Inc said Monday it would report a net loss of $0.05 a share for the fourth quarter.
The company, which makes proprietary products for the healthcare industry, said the low results for the quarter were due to lower than expected sales of its Myocardial Protection System.
They were also due to the company writing off $196,000 as bad debt when a distributor of its Advanced Neuromodulation System line filed for bankruptcy protection.

"In the short term, to accelerate the adoption of MPS and shorten the selling process, we will be offering MPS on a one- year rental basis as well as on a lease-purchase basis," it said. "This strategy will decrease revenues in the near term because rentals don't qualify as sales of the units, but this should accelerate placement of MPS systems and related disposable revenues."
Quest Medical also said it foresaw a net share loss of $0.05 for the year against a loss of $1.56 for the previous year.
First Call's analysts' consensus foresaw a profit of $0.04 a share for the fourth quarter and the year.
